acceptance_criteria: At least 12 scheduled weeks have been observed
Net return after all modeled costs is positive
Risk-adjusted performance is better than BTC buy-and-hold or drawdown is materially reduced without eliminating return
Turnover and costs do not consume the gross edge
Results are not dependent on a single asset or a single trade
Observed paper execution is consistent with locked backtest assumptions
Any consideration of real money requires explicit human review and a separate authorization

benchmark_definitions.btc_buy_and_hold: One virtual BTC allocation established at the first genuine forward observation and valued only at the strategy observation timestamps
benchmark_definitions.equal_weight_five_asset: Static 20 percent initial allocation to each of BTC, ETH, BNB, XRP and TRX, valued only at identical forward observation timestamps

incident_policy.data_failure: No trade; activate kill switch and record DATA_QUALITY_FAILURE
incident_policy.execution_error: No replay; reconcile committed state and record EXECUTION_ERROR
incident_policy.missed_window: Record MISSED_SCHEDULE; never backdate or fabricate a trade
incident_policy.notification_failure: Keep committed portfolio state; retry Telegram only with the original run ID
incident_policy.overlap: Refuse the second process; no portfolio mutation
incident_policy.reconciliation_failure: No trade; activate kill switch; manual investigation and explicit reset only

prohibited_changes: Modify, optimize, replace or reselect the locked strategy
Use final-test results to tune any parameter
Reopen the 96-configuration search or create additional combinations
Overwrite or delete historical experiments, orders, fills, ledgers, reports or records
Add real-order methods, private exchange endpoints, Binance credentials, withdrawals, leverage, margin, derivatives or short selling
Allow an LLM to generate signals or portfolio weights
rejection_criteria: Any unresolved reconciliation error or duplicate execution
Non-positive net return after modeled costs at formal evaluation
Turnover or modeled costs consume the gross edge
Performance depends materially on one asset or one trade
Paper execution is inconsistent with locked backtest assumptions
Operational integrity is insufficient for scientific interpretation
research_status: forward paper experiment only; not a proven profitable strategy
